title: Ask about your workspace
description: Answers come from this demo's projects, tasks and activity. Nothing leaves your browser, and the replies are scripted.
suggestions: How do I list projects with the API?

How do I list projects with the API?

fallback: I can only answer a few scripted questions in this demo: which projects are at risk, what changed this week, and how to list projects with the API. Try one of those below.

api.intro: Create a read-only key under [Settings › API keys](/app/demo/settings/api-keys), then send it as a bearer token. The endpoint returns every project with its status, owner, due date and task counts.
api.outro: Keys are shown once when you create them. This demo's API is illustrative, so the address does not respond.
